1b
Payments ready?
✕ Needs attention

Asks Stripe, Tabby and Tamara, with the keys the shop holds, whether everything is set for kbeautybliss.com, and checks cash on delivery. It only reads: nothing is changed at any provider. Run it before the switch, and again after step 7.

Check everything again

Checked 10/8/2026, 8:32:27 AM · 17 green, 2 amber, 5 red · main address kbeautybliss.com.

Card (Stripe)
Fix this
Offered at checkout: Card payment is switched on. Mode: Live.
Keys: Secret key …Cd34 and publishable key …Ab12 are both LIVE keys, matching Mode.
Stripe account: Reachable (K-Beauty Bliss), and Stripe allows it to take payments.
Webhook: Still points at extrabeauty.ae (https://extrabeauty.ae/api/payments/webhook/stripe/…cdef), not at kbeautybliss.com.
→ Press “Set up webhook automatically” in Store → Payments → Stripe (or step 7 of this page).
Webhook events: Listens to all 7 events the shop acts on.
Signing secret: Present, so the shop can prove a notice really came from Stripe.
Apple Pay / Google Pay · kbeautybliss.com: kbeautybliss.com is not registered with Stripe for wallets, so the Apple Pay button will not show there.
→ Stripe dashboard → Settings → Payment method domains → Add kbeautybliss.com.
Card statement text: Valid: “K-Beauty Bliss”.
Last card payment: No card payment has been tried yet.
Tabby
Fix this
Offered at checkout: Tabby is switched on.
Keys: Secret key …view and public key …view are both SANDBOX keys.
Mode: These are sandbox keys: no real instalment is taken.
→ Paste your live keys in Store → Payments → Tabby when your test orders pass.
Merchant code: AE (from the shop’s currency).
Tabby account: Tabby accepted the secret key for AE.
Webhook: Still points at extrabeauty.ae (https://extrabeauty.ae/api/payments/webhook/tabby/…cdef), not at kbeautybliss.com.
→ Press “Register / re-sync” in Store → Gateway webhooks → Tabby (or step 7 of this page).
Tamara
Fix this
Offered at checkout: Tamara is switched on.
Mode: Sandbox: the shop talks to api-sandbox.tamara.co and no real plan is taken.
→ Switch Mode to Live in Store → Payments → Tamara (with your live token) when your test orders pass.
Notification token: Present, so the shop can check a notice really came from Tamara.
Tamara account: Tamara’s SANDBOX server refused the API token …view.
→ A sandbox token works only with Mode = Sandbox, a live one only with Live. Fix the token or Mode in Store → Payments → Tamara.
Order notices: Points at https://kbeautybliss.com/api/payments/webhook/tamara/…cdef, the main address.
Webhook: Tamara no longer knows the registration this shop holds.
→ Press “Remove the registration”, then “Register the webhook” in Store → Gateway webhooks → Tamara (or step 7 of this page).
Cash on delivery
All good
Offered at checkout: Cash on delivery is switched on.
Fee: AED 10 per order.
Limits: No lower or upper limit: offered on every basket.
